description: Land Title Settlement Department - Akkaramale Janapadaya, Udapalatha D/S Division Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320207
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of 153 specific land parcels in a defined geographical area, with a detailed schedule listing parcel numbers, extents, owners (all "The State"), and land classifications. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it concerns land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
